title: Session namer
summary: Names each session with a short project key and title, such as "WEB fix login".
benefit: Session lists show what each session is about, so they are easy to find.
solves: A session list full of unnamed or random names you cannot tell apart.
use_cases: Each session gets a short name that starts with a project key, such as "APP records export".
The name follows the work: when the session moves to another topic, it is renamed.
A name you set yourself is kept while it still fits the work.
You choose the projects folder and your own key per project, for example webshop = SHOP.
details: Each session gets a short name such as WEB fix login, built from a project key and what the session is about. It is for you if you keep several sessions open and want to tell them apart at a glance. It copies a hook script and adds a UserPromptSubmit entry to your settings; the script runs on prompts and makes a small background Haiku call, which costs a little usage.

values.ask: Folder that holds your projects, full path or inside your home folder; several as a JSON list, for example ["Desktop/code","Desktop/Projects"] (leave empty for Desktop/Projects)
Project folder name (lower case) to a key of at most 4 capital letters, as JSON, for example {"webshop":"SHOP"} (leave {} to derive keys from folder names)

cost_note: Each naming makes a small background Haiku call, and verify makes one too; both use a little of your usage.
risk: Runs on prompts and starts a small background Haiku call to name each session, which costs a little usage.
